title: Ligation Sequencing Kit: DNA Repair and End-Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: After 5 minutes, while engaged, remove supernatant
Engage magnet until eluate is clear (5 minutes)

steps.title: Transfer master mix
steps.instruction: Pipette the DNA repair and end‑prep master mix into the designated PCR plate.

steps.title: Pre‑heat thermocycler
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler block to 20 °C and the lid temperature to 70 °C, then mix the plate and pause for a spin‑down.

steps.title: Incubate plate
steps.instruction: Run the thermocycler program: 20 °C for 5 minutes followed by 65 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the AMPure XP beads in each well by pipette mixing.

steps.title: Transfer samples to MIDI plate
steps.instruction: Move the samples from the Bio‑Rad plate (on the thermocycler) to the MIDI plate positioned on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add AMPure XP beads
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of AMPure XP beads to each sample on the MIDI plate.

steps.title: Mix samples on MIDI plate
steps.instruction: Pipette‑mix each well on the MIDI plate to ensure thorough mixing of beads and sample.

steps.title: Hula mixer pause
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for the Hula mixer step (optional mixing).

steps.title: Spin‑down pause
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for a brief spin‑down of the plate.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and wait 5 minutes for beads to pellet.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: While the magnet remains engaged, aspirate and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: While the magnet remains engaged, add 200 µL of ethanol to each well, then remove the ethanol and discard the tip.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash: add 200 µL ethanol, then remove ethanol and discard the tip.

steps.title: Post‑wash spin‑down
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for a brief spin‑down after the ethanol washes.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: While the magnet is still engaged, remove any remaining ethanol and wait 30 seconds for drying.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Disengage the magnetic module, add 61 µL nuclease‑free water to each well, and incubate 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Re‑engage magnet for eluate
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module and wait 5 minutes until the eluate is clear.

steps.title: Transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer 61 µL of the clear eluate into the Bio‑Rad PCR plate (Slot 2) for the next part of the protocol.
